title: Spiral density waves in a young protoplanetary disk
question: Does the Elias 2-27 disk show spiral density waves in the midplane, traced by optically thin 1.3 mm dust emission, and what drives them?

data.bands: 1.3 mm continuum plus CO J=2-1 lines

what.value: Surface density constraint (Sigma_c=0.05 g cm-2, R_c=200 AU, gamma=0.7, kappa=2.4 cm2/g) used in radiative transfer model

evidence.quote: The parameters adopted, based on the previous constraint on this disk (*20*), are: $\Sigma_c = 0.05$ g cm$^{-2}$, $R_c = 200$ AU, $\gamma = 0.7$

what.value: Stellar mass 0.5 +/- 0.2 Msun used for Keplerian profile

evidence.quote: We compute the corresponding Keplerian profile for a stellar mass of $0.5 \pm 0.2\; M_{\odot}$

recipe.method: Amplitude and phase self-calibration then multiscale clean, Briggs robust 1.0

recipe.goal: Estimate optical depth and Toomre Q
recipe.method: Radiative transfer of azimuthally averaged profile with adopted surface density
assumptions: gas-to-dust ratio 100; kappa 2.4 cm2/g (RT), 2.3 cm2/g (Toomre Q)

recipe.goal: Fit spirals and dark ring geometry
recipe.method: Subtract best-fit radial profile, find local maxima/minima every 12 deg, fit ring and two log spirals with MCMC
assumptions: Ring and spirals share single i and PA

recipe.method: Ratio of spiral peak to minimum surface brightness at each deprojected radius

recipe.goal: Determine rotation sense and trailing nature from CO
recipe.method: CO channel maps, PV diagram vs Keplerian curve, near/far side asymmetry

evidence.quote: We find both arms have similar contrasts ranging between values of 1.3 and 2.5.
$\tau=0.1$ at $R=100$ AU, decreasing to $\tau=0.02$ at $R=300$ AU

not_stated_but_needed: Self-calibration solution intervals and number of iterations
Clean mask, threshold, cell and image size, multiscale scales
Initial model for self-cal and flux scale uncertainty
Settings of the unsharp-mask/background profile functional form and MCMC priors, walkers, steps
Line-free channels and continuum subtraction for CO
RADMC-3D setup (grid, stellar parameters, dust composition)
missing_for_reproduction: MCMC priors and the smooth background profile form
score_reason: Public data and clear geometric fitting results, but self-cal and clean settings are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric geometry results, moderately complete recipe.
